data.name: Karee
data.gender_notes: Karee is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Karee means 'pure, clear, bright'. This name was given to the goddess Persephone when she was abducted and taken to the underworld. It represents the idea of renewal and rebirth, as well as the strength and purity of the spirit. The name Karee carries the meaning “Pure, Clear, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Karee usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the renewal and rebirth of the spirit.
data.etymology: Karee belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clear, Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karee total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
